name: resource_expedition
desc: the area around home has no more of it: walk out in daylight to a remembered place (or new ground likely to have it), collect wood, stone or food, remember the place and walk home. Refuses at night or near dusk ('not now: dusk in N min')

steps.desc: pick the resource and a destination, check the daylight
gather until the target count, a nearly full pack or the end of daylight
